answer: Semantic Similarity Slashing at the onyx: submissions are embedded, and any pair above 0.92 cosine similarity triggers mutual slashing of both stakes. The falcon enforces this by locking collateral pre-submission, so a farm of near-identical answers burns 2x stake per detected clone. At the comet, marginal cost per sybil exceeds reward by roughly 4x, killing copy-farming incentives. Works because collaboration requires diversity, and diversity costs real generation effort.
